codex.root:
Observed findings — future usefulness unvalidated; apply only when the stated activity fits:
- [transfer-review; finding:catalog-20260910:transfer-review] When reusing a repair, compare the source and target semantics and test their boundary cases. JavaScript trim() does not cover every Unicode whitespace character.
  Observed: The guided fix accepted U+0085; baseline rejected it. Source repair verification did not establish transfer to the new Unicode contract. Evidence: task-report:0310e7eda0cf7381213dc3013198fb5c025380db2ab04a11173ecd36651cef17
- [experiment-design; finding:catalog-20260910:experiment-design] Before comparing interventions, audit verifier coverage, fix ambient guidance, and measure execution separately from approval waiting.
  Observed: Both arms passed the frozen verifier, which omitted U+0085. Legacy guidance varied in order, and approval waiting distorted the timing comparison. Evidence: task-report:0310e7eda0cf7381213dc3013198fb5c025380db2ab04a11173ecd36651cef17
- [learning-budget; finding:catalog-20260910:learning-budget] Before a learning trial, set an enforceable spending limit and include acquisition, evaluation and orchestration costs. A post-run budget check cannot stop token use.
  Observed: Both attempts exceeded 100,000 tokens. Evaluation spent 324,915 tokens with no validated benefit; engineering and orchestration added millions more. Evidence: task-report:0310e7eda0cf7381213dc3013198fb5c025380db2ab04a11173ecd36651cef17
